Also read Agekumo Maru; ex Ethel Moller, 912 GRT (the comment). The post summarises a BAAG report: arrived Hong Kong from Shanghai via Formosa, inward cargo anti-aircraft guns and ammunition, discharged 21-22 July to the Tsim Sha Tsui barracks; it dates the arrival 20 July. A reader's comment (P. Cundall, 4 Dec 2018, no source cited) puts her in TA-406 Shanghai to Takao and then No. 91 Takao to Hong Kong with Nitto, Kyodo No. 28 and Gyoyu Maru, the only one of four to survive, arriving 5 July.
